source_dataset: CFTC TFF Futures Only gpe5-46if, CME Bitcoin code 133741
signal: delta of (AssetManagerLong-AssetManagerShort)/OpenInterest from report t-1 to t
signal_predecessor_rule: trade report t only when report t and the immediately preceding chronological CFTC report are both publication-timing eligible; no bridge across excluded reports
direction: LONG if delta>0; SHORT if delta<0; no trade if delta=0
entry: 00:00 UTC first Tuesday after public availability per frozen publication timing policy
price_authority: Binance Data Vision BTCUSDT spot 1d open

bootstrap.method: iid trade bootstrap of mean NET10 bps, 9999 resamples
